note: P16b Tasks 23 and 24 (chunk c6): the game of postures and the posture call's schemes B and C. The functions of posture.html that its README calls normative, copied (types added): the dial as the surface (`bigSize`, `targetPose`, `activePoints`, `driftOf`, `blendedBody`, `anchors`, `drawDial`, `circle`, `drawBeads`, `drawLabel`, `fictionClock`: 300 px, the target as a dashed ghost, a point past 22 ringed in amber, the feet's ring at the ankles, the beads 1 TORSO to 7 FEET with their drift as amber), the hold (`startHold`, `endHold`, `rateOf`, `step`: +40 % over the first 120 s, the self-feeding past 50, the fiction clock at 30 s a second times (1 + 0.25 per level), her attention's phases of 6 to 15 s, the pages turned while she is busy, the blind view's feel lines at 40 and 72, `feelLines`), the corrections (`press`: loudness (drift / 100)^1.4, the cloth sound at 0.05 + loud x 0.5 and its rate, the creak above 0.55, the jolt above 0.3, a correction louder than `SEEN` under her eyes is fidgeting she sees, every third a slip; `release`), the faults (`fault`, `slip`: she puts the point back at 35; `jolt`), her world (`event`: a visitor, her undressing, a sound behind, "look at me" and its trap by style; `lookUp`; `setAttention`: her sprite's brightness .78 / .9 / 1.03, the darkened edges and the wood creak when she watches), the call (`statesFor`, `startCall`, `scheduleTaps`, `callPress`, `matches`, `checkTaken`, `pickState`, `drawStates`, `hintLevel`, `ghostShown`, `hintOn`, `pointsShown`, `drawCallDial`, `present`, `endCall`, `callTick`), her words (`say`, `feel`, `pickLine`, `STATE_WORD`) and the film (`drawGrain`, `sizeGrain`, `frame`). Tables: the engine's `TUNING.craft.posture` equals the prototype's `DRIFT_TO`, `SEEN`, `TRAP` and constants; `RATE` and `ARM_RATE` are the prototype's defaults the preset registry's rows use (three presets' own rows differ). Lines: `LINES` are the `cardVoice` rows `posture.<kind>` by style (card-voice.md section 16; verbatim; a style the prototype has no row of reads neutral's; cold's own, silent where it has none; the prototype's cruel `clean` and `taken` and regal `watch` are empty lines it reads as neutral's, so they have no row). Declared beyond the functions: (1) the wiring (posture.ts header): `performance`, `setTimeout`, `clearTimeout`, `requestAnimationFrame`, `innerWidth` / `innerHeight`, `document` (its body is the film, its root the surface) and `$` are the mount's own; the panel's controls the prototype reads answer from the state and the settings (`$('#skill')` the commander's posture level, `#mastery` this posture's mastery on the pair, `#hintStates` the SYS easing or her first call of a taught posture); the sounds are the extension's files through the sample layer; the dial is the prototype's own, drawn in the moment layer over the scene while the real one is hidden. (2) The mount: one surface for the hold and for the call (the call draws its own when no hold is under it); the keys 1-7 and L act only when nothing editable has the focus and the device is down (`env.root.closest('[inert]')`), 6 is held through a temptation; the stop word is the scene's pill, moved to the prototype's corner (css/86-posture.css). (3) Prototype only, not ported: the panel, the log line and the stats, the hold's start and end (Space, `end`), the stop pill, the stand-in scene, the `__` hooks.

differences.reason: Wiring: the hold is the engine's (`practices.postureRun`): its id, her term (`until` beats of 1.5 s, hidden or not: the prototype's term picker), where it resumes after a remount (`WR.t0`, the beats the engine counted) replace the panel's term select and `Date.now()`; `eyes` and `blind` are the prototype's own `$('#eyesRule')` / `$('#blind')`, answered from the preset and `sensoryNow`.

Wiring: a hold that ran to her term is reported to the engine once (`posture/end` released, the beats it ran; `reportEnd`), which pays it and keeps its record; a hold ended by the stop word, a call or a scene that is gone reports nothing here (the engine ended it, or `callAnswered` does).

Wiring: the engine owns the rates: `driftRates` (the preset's own rate per point, times the day's fatigue, a hard floor, her weight, (1 - 0.08 per capacity level of the commander's posture) and (1 - 0.05 per level of this posture on the pair)) is what the prototype's `ARM_RATE` / `RATE` and `mult()` compute from its panel; the hold's own tiring (+40 % over 120 s) and the self-feeding past 50 stay the prototype's. Three presets' own rows differ from the prototype's tables (`kneel_arched`, `light_bearer`, `hogtied`: blocking.md section 7.3).

differences.reason: Wiring: her attention is the engine's plan (`attentionAt`: her activity's weights, a clinical holder always watching) read at the start of each of the prototype's 6-15 s phases, in place of the prototype's hashed pick (45 / 30 / 25 %); the phase's length stays the prototype's hash.

Wiring: a visitor and her undressing are events of the scene, so the engine's `temptations` play them (`playTemptations`, each once, after its hashed delay); the prototype's hashed timeline keeps only what the engine has no event for, "a sound behind" (30 %) and "look at me" (15 %), with the prototype's own bands of the same `k`.

Wiring: whether she saw the correction is the engine's answer (`posture/correct` with the drift at the press and her attention as shown: the noise by the preset and the commander's stillness, the seen thresholds `SEEN`); the prototype's own rule (`loud > SEEN[attention]`) is the fallback when no answer comes (`engineSeen`).
Wiring: the order not obeyed is reported to the engine as a slip of the point `gaze` (`posture/slip`: the engine has no point-less fault); the prototype's own count and her line stay.

Wiring: a slip is reported to the engine (`posture/slip`, one offence of hers, the streak starts over), except a fidgeting one: the engine counted that one itself when it judged the third seen correction.

Wiring: the call is the engine's: the posture she calls is the series' last (or the only) one (`callIndex`; the earlier calls of a series C are a hashed pick that is neither the body's nor the last), and a trap in C is a hash of the call and its place instead of `Date.now()`.

Wiring: without the order interaction a call to assemble has no time to be late in; a trap still ends at the window (holding still is right).
